item.title: “I have to hate Springsteen now, too?” ask tearful Magaloons, realising all that’s left for them is Kid Rock
item.description: Following Bruce Springsteen's release of a new song criticising the Trump regime's actions in Minnesota, a large percentage of MAGA followers have expressed dismay as they felt duty-bound to immediately purge and burn all their Springsteen records.

item.title: Tesla revenue shrinks in rapidly growing EV market as customers show reluctance to give money to bellends
item.description: Tesla has reported a significant fall in revenue for 2025, despite the electric vehicle market growing by roughly 25%, prompting analysts to confirm that EV consumers are showing increasing reluctance to give money to twats.

item.title: “Britain is the greatest country in the world that’s a big pile of shit and we hate it,” say Reform
item.description: The insurgent Reform Party appear to have settled on a core message, that Britain is the greatest country in the world, that they hate it, and it’s awful.

item.title: “…and you lot can f**k off as well,” Badenoch tells Tory voters
item.description: Kemi Badenoch has followed up her criticism of those MPs who’ve left the party for Reform and the newly formed Prosper group of centrists by launching a stinging attack on the people who actually vote for the party.

item.title: We went to the cinema to see the Melania documentary so you don’t have to – this is what we discovered

item.title: Elon Musk avoids Epstein questions by hiding in empty ‘Melania’ screening
item.description: The world’s richest man Elon Musk has managed to evade questions surrounding his relationship with paedophile Jeffrey Epstein by hiding in an empty screening of the new ‘Melania’ documentary.
